adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that in topic_embed.rb line 22, PostCreator is called with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and `skip_validations: true`. Looking at post.rb lines 131-133, when cook_method is raw_html, the cook method returns `raw` directly without any sanitization. The content comes from RSS feeds (poll_feed.rb) or remote URLs (import_remote) and is stored/rendered as raw HTML. While ruby-readability does some tag filtering, the RSS feed path in poll_feed.rb uses `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` which doesn't sanitize for XSS. This creates a persistent XSS vulnerability where malicious content in feeds could execute JavaScript in users' browsers.
